concerns.text: FR-014 adds a two‑stage graph generation process (Barabási–Albert preferential‑attachment model to create a noisy *Proxy Graph*) that was not mentioned in the original idea. The idea only required using the LoRA Topology Graph directly for the Topological Lookahead policy. This extra modeling step expands the research scope beyond what was proposed.
FR-016 mandates a specific project directory layout. The original idea did not specify any filesystem structure; this is an engineering detail beyond the research scope.
FR-017 requires a `requirements.txt` file with a fixed list of packages. While useful for implementation, the idea did not request a concrete dependency list, making this an out‑of‑scope artifact.
FR-018 demands linting (ruff) and formatting (black) configuration. The research idea did not include code‑style tooling, so this requirement exceeds the intended scope.
